nodes.name: Zoom Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Zoom webinar events: registration_created, participant_joined/left, ended, plus endpoint.url_validation. Responds via Respond to Webhook nodes. 12 pinned fictional deliveries.

nodes.name: Verify Signature & Normalize Event
nodes.notes: x-zm-signature over v0:{ts}:{raw body} · URL validation (oracle-safe) · replay window · e-mail normalisation · ledger.

nodes.name: Respond URL Validation
nodes.notes: Returns { plainToken, encryptedToken } within Zoom's 3-second window.

nodes.name: Acknowledge Event
nodes.notes: 200 straight away; processing continues after the response.

nodes.name: Respond Rejected or Ignored
nodes.notes: 401 for bad signatures, 200 for ignored events (so Zoom doesn't retry).

nodes.name: Wait for Zoom Reports
nodes.notes: Zoom finalises webinar reports a few minutes after the webinar ends (ZOOM_REPORT_DELAY_MINUTES).

nodes.name: Get Zoom Access Token
nodes.notes: Server-to-Server OAuth · scopes report:read:admin (or granular report:read:list_webinar_participants:admin, report:read:webinar_qa:admin).

nodes.name: Build Attendance Summaries
nodes.notes: Merges sessions per attendee · overlap-safe minutes · Q&A counts · engagement tier.

nodes.name: Plan Contact & Custom Event Updates
nodes.notes: Create rules · latest-webinar properties · UUID-guarded totals · custom events.

nodes.name: Upsert Contact
nodes.notes: batch/update (known contact) or batch/upsert by e-mail (new registrant) · idempotent, retried.

nodes.name: Send Custom Events
nodes.notes: Scope analytics.behavioral_events.send · events need existing definitions (pe{portalId}_…) · not auto-retried.

nodes.name: Audit Logger
nodes.notes: Masked e-mails, metrics and IDs only · stdout + ring buffer.

nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when this workflow is selected as its own Error Workflow.

parameters.content:
## n8n-zoom-webinar-hubspot-engagement-sync
Zoom webinar registration, attendance and Q&A → HubSpot contact properties + custom timeline events. dhRobin Systems.

**Safe defaults:** `SANDBOX_MODE=true`, `DRY_RUN=true`. No Zoom API, HubSpot or Slack calls until both are `false`.

**Stage 1** Execute *Zoom Webhook Trigger* (12 fictional deliveries).
**Stage 2** `SANDBOX_MODE=false`: real Zoom reports + contact search, writes simulated.
**Stage 3** `DRY_RUN=false`: contact updates and custom events go live.

Activate the workflow before saving the endpoint in Zoom (URL validation).

### After webinar.ended
Wait → Server-to-Server OAuth token → Q&A report → participants report (paged) → one summary per external attendee.

### Sanitized error path
No stack traces, headers or bodies. Secrets, access tokens and webhook URLs are redacted.
